name: Speed of the Mamba
body:
School transmutation; Level: alchemist 2, druid 2, serpent druid 2, magus 2, serpent warlock 2, snake cultist leader 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner 2, witch 2

Components: V, S, M (the scale of a black mamba)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target(s): One creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 20 ft. apart

Duration: 1 round/2 levels

Saving Throw: Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

This spell has the same effects as haste, but works only on snakes and snake-like creatures. Examples of snake-like creatures include a couatl, marilith demon, naga, or any creature whose anatomy includes a snake’s head or body. Merely having tentacles, slit eyes, scales or a forked tongue is not enough to qualify a creature as snake-like.
